chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya al-Halabi, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the last two rak'ahs of Zuhr. He said: You glorify Allah, praise Allah, and seek forgiveness for your sin; and if you wish, then [recite] Fatihat al-Kitab, for it is praise and supplication.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ: the final two units of the prayer
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Surat al-Fatihah, the Opening of the Book

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the last two rak'ahs of Zuhr prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that in the last two rak'ahs of Zuhr prayer, one may engage in tasbih, praise of Allah, and seeking forgiveness. It also permits reciting Fatihat al-Kitab instead, explaining that it comprises praise and du'a.
